---
name: code-review
description: Review diffs for concrete defects, security issues, regressions, and maintainability problems.
---
# Code Review Skill
- Initialize Caveman first.
- Review the actual diff against the original request, approved requirements, and plan.
- Inspect relevant surrounding code.
- Prioritize actionable correctness and security findings.
- Check regressions, validation, error handling, permissions, data integrity, and exposed secrets.
- For OddlyFound, consider affiliate destinations/disclosures, CMS access, content integrity, SEO, accessibility, responsive behavior, and client-side overhead where relevant.
- Do not flag mere preferences as defects.
- Each finding needs severity, location, impact, and recommended fix.
- Do not change files unless explicitly asked.
- If no findings exist, say so and disclose limitations.
- Do not claim tests ran unless they did.
